objective: Build RoadGuard AI: a functional FastAPI + React/TypeScript road damage detection and monitoring platform with real YOLO inference, persistent reports, Leaflet map, explainable prioritisation, analytics, exports, tests and documented model workflow.
acceptance_criteria: AC1 backend and frontend start with documented commands
AC2 valid road photo upload is validated (extension, MIME, magic bytes, size, integrity)
AC3 detection model loads once at startup when weights are present; missing weights return an honest actionable error
AC4 inference returns real detections (class, confidence, bbox) plus an annotated image, never fabricated
AC5 report submission with GPS or manually picked coordinates persists a report with reference ID
AC6 report renders at the correct position on the Leaflet map with filters and popups
AC7 dashboard KPIs and charts are computed from stored records and degrade gracefully when empty
AC8 authorised reviewer can transition status and record repair updates with audit history
AC9 reports and analytics export as CSV, JSON and PDF from real records
AC10 data persists across application restart
AC11 backend test suite passes and frontend type-check + production build succeed (evidence recorded)
non_goals: training a production road-damage model inside this environment
fabricating evaluation metrics or synthetic detections presented as real inference
multi-tenant cloud deployment, email delivery, SMS
